verdict.reasons: Valid product identity with clear AFP branding and appropriate drip-tape context. Core conditions are met. Minor advisory notes: coiled black drip lines slightly resemble hose-family at first glance and the white tape piece is a small contextual element; neither disrupts the coherent illustration. focused_physical_review.reason: The continuous black irrigation line is visible to the right of the package and does not touch, cross, or disappear underneath it. However, a broad uninterrupted soil gap is not visible around the complete footprint of the package, and a distinct, additional loose coil of uninstalled product is clearly visible on the soil to the right of the package. Additionally, a white protruding strip (resembling tape or a ribbon tail) is visible emerging from the base of the white-and-blue AFP package.
